brief:
The Palestine Convoy, which departed Bosnia and Herzegovina in solidarity with Gaza and the West Bank, remains waiting at the Ibrahim al-Khalil border crossing between Iraq and Turkey, the Shehab Wire reported. The convoy has halted its journey as officials work to resolve obstacles to its passage.

Diplomatic and logistical efforts are underway to clear the route for the convoy to resume travel. No timeline for the crossing has been announced.
